issues.evidence: Line 2 has a second ཡོངས་བསྔོ (“བྱང་ཆུབ་འདུ་ཤེས་ཡོངས་བསྔོ་སེམས་ཅན་འདུ་ཤེས”); bo-mipham 2-42 glosses it as the perception attached to the object of dedication (“ཡོངས་སུ་བསྔོ་ཡུལ་གྱི་སེམས་ཅན་དུ་འདུ་ཤེས”) and awakening as the basis of dedication (“བསྔོ་བའི་གནས་བྱང་ཆུབ”). The English renders ཡོངས་བསྔོ only once, in line 1.
issues.fix: And if there is the perception of awakening [as that to which one dedicates] and the perception of sentient beings [as those for whom one dedicates]

issues.evidence: Tibetan has only བྱང་ཆུབ་སེམས་དཔའ (locked: bodhisattva); “seeking awakening” is an added gloss (bo-mipham 2-50: “བྱང་ཆུབ་སེམས་དཔའ་དམིགས་པ་ཅན”).

Tibetan “ཁྲག་ཁྲིག་མང་” (many ཁྲག་ཁྲིག, niyuta; bo-mipham 2-50 “ཁྲག་ཁྲིག་མང་པོ”); the same number is rendered “hundreds of billions” elsewhere in this batch (2-39, 2-47), so “billions” understates and is inconsistent.
issues.fix: many hundreds of billions of sentient beings

issues.span: those fully entered into supreme awakening
issues.evidence: བྱང་ཆུབ་དམ་པར་རབ་ཞུགས = those who have set out/engaged on the path to supreme awakening (bo-khenrab 4-6: “བྱང་ཆུབ་དམ་པར་རབ་ཏུ་ཞུགས་པ”, who gradually enter through hearing/reflecting/meditating). “Entered into awakening” can be read as having attained it, which the last line (they will touch awakening before long) excludes.
issues.fix: those who have fully set out toward supreme awakening
